policyDefinitions.early6: Bottle oldest cask if age>=6, list immediately.
policyDefinitions.wait36: Bottle oldest cask if age>=36, list immediately; does not override rule on funds stop.
policyDefinitions.cashAware24: Bottle oldest cask if age>=24 OR cash minus all bottling reserves is less than3 maintenance months; list immediately.
policyDefinitions.autumnStock: Bottle oldest cask age>=12 during autumn or winter; store unlisted in autumn and list at first winter decision. Does not override rule on funds stop.
policyDefinitions.common: At most one bottling per elapsed-month decision, then open at most one66/refill batch if canStart. If full bottling cannot be paid, try5 bottles. No price optimization. Each run ends at36 elapsed months or first blocked month; this is a policy stall, not automatically a game softlock.

limits: Prepared fixtures provide starting assets; their creation costs are not subtracted. Same fixture core is identical across conditions, but fixtures have different assets/capital.
Four fixed policies are finite probes, not optimal or human policies. Cash change includes liquidation of provided starting stock; it is not proof of sustainable profit.
36-month horizon can leave unsold products and younger assets, so final cash alone cannot rank policies.
No flavor score, contest, price prediction or seasonal bonus on bottling. Season modifies actual later retail wishes under shared customer cap24.
Stored bottles preserve taste. Their label age is age at bottling, not calendar age of bottle.
Fund guard rejects a whole monthly transaction. Blocked attempts do not age or pay another month. Recovery counterfactuals try listing stock or5bottle lots only.
Autumn counterfactuals share a snapshot but bottling at different dates changes profile, count and fees; same20 mode isolates equal count but cask slot remains occupied.
Winter can have the highest raw demand; cap, rounding, carry cost and timing mean this does not establish a universal bottling date.
Real market seasonality, human bottling motives, subjective enjoyment and main long-term economy are not verified.
